title: InsureMate Week 4 Software Engineering Model Comparison
description: Same software-engineering evaluation tasks used across CodeLlama, Phi-3 Mini and Qwen 2.5 1.5B.

questions.question: Explain the purpose of backend/app/services/document_processor.py and describe what process_pdf() does.
Explain how backend/app/services/embedding_service.py generates an embedding for a piece of text.
Explain how cosine similarity is calculated in backend/app/services/retrieval_service.py.
Explain the complete flow from a user question to retrieved policy chunks and the final LLM answer in InsureMate.
Which file contains the function generate_embedding()?
Which file contains the cosine_similarity() function?
Which file contains the retrieve() function that returns the top-k most relevant chunks?
Which backend API module exposes the retrieval endpoint used to search policy evidence?
Which service does retrieval_service.py depend on to create the query embedding, and why is that dependency required?
Trace the dependencies involved when process_pdf() is used to prepare a policy document for embedding.
Explain how the API layer, document processing service, embedding service and retrieval service work together in InsureMate.
If embedding_service.py could no longer generate embeddings, which parts of the retrieval pipeline would be affected and why?
The frontend displays 'Failed to fetch' when requesting data from the backend. What are the likely causes in this InsureMate architecture?
The backend raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pypdf' while processing a policy PDF. Identify the cause and explain how to fix it.
The retrieval system returns policy chunks that are unrelated to the user's question. Based on the retrieval implementation, identify possible causes.
A retrieval result always receives a similarity score of 0. Explain which conditions in cosine_similarity() can cause this and how you would debug it.
Write a Python function cosine_similarity(a, b) that calculates cosine similarity between two numeric vectors and safely handles zero-magnitude vectors.
Write a Python function that takes a list of retrieval result dictionaries containing a 'score' field and returns the top 5 results sorted from highest to lowest score.
Write a FastAPI GET endpoint /health that returns {'status': 'ok'}.
Write a pytest test for cosine_similarity() that verifies two identical non-zero vectors return a similarity close to 1.0.
Refactor the cosine_similarity() implementation to improve readability without changing its behaviour. Explain what you changed.
Refactor the retrieve() function so that the similarity calculation and result creation are easier to understand while preserving its output.
Suggest a cleaner structure for separating embedding generation from retrieval logic in InsureMate. Identify which responsibilities should remain in each service.
Review the document processing and embedding pipeline and suggest refactoring improvements that reduce duplication while preserving the existing behaviour.
According to the Group Health Insurance policy, what is the waiting period mentioned for pre-existing diseases?
Does the Group Health Insurance policy cover hospitalization expenses?
Compare the waiting period information available in Group Health Insurance and Health Companion Insurance.
What does the Travel Insurance policy say about emergency medical expenses and medical evacuation?
